name: Can I replace just the glass in my patio door, or do I need a new door?
description: You can often replace just the glass unit if the frame is sound; otherwise, a full door replacement may be necessary.

mainEntity.name: Can I replace just the glass in my patio door, or do I need a new door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, you can replace just the glass unit (the insulated glass unit or IGU) if the door frame is in good condition. However, if the frame is damaged, rotting, or severely warped, or if your door is an older, less common model where individual glass replacement isn't feasible, a full door replacement might be more cost-effective in the long run. We can help you assess the condition of your existing door and advise on the best approach for your home in Pleasanton or Hayward.
